content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim was timely, authorization was not required, and the diagnosis/CPT pairing is valid, so neither retro-authorization nor claim correction is indicated. Because CO-97 is an adjudicated bundling denial, resubmission risks another denial and the balance should not be shifted to the patient without establishing contractual liability. File an appeal supporting the separately warranted service with the available clinical documentation."}
